observations.statement: Between 2026-09-19…2026-10-02 vs 2026-10-03…2026-10-16 the tracked conversion rate went from 4.06% to 2.66% (−34.4%); the change is statistically significant (p < 0.001).
Daily conversion rate averaged 4.07% before 2026-10-04 and 2.54% from 2026-10-04 on (change point; 15 vs 13 days, −37.7%).
mobile explains 103% of the tracked CR change (−1.43 pp of −1.40 pp): share of sessions 60.2% → 60.0%, CR 3.88% → 1.48%, clicks→sessions 0.9 → 0.9.
mobile: 5xx rate 0.0% → 21.4%, availability 100.0% → 78.6%, p95 1,694 → 8,341 ms, p50 1,303 → 2,982 ms (56 checks in the current period).
Deployed version changed v1.9.3 → v2.0.0, first seen by monitoring at 2026-10-04 12:00 UTC.
Pixel and backend agree: the pixel recorded 97% of backend-confirmed conversions in the baseline (567 of 586) and 97% in the current period (371 of 382).

evidenceIndex.E1: Baseline 2026-09-19…2026-10-02: 13,978 sessions, 567 tracked conversions, CR 4.06%, spend $26,094.16; current 2026-10-03…2026-10-16: 13,952 sessions, 371 tracked conversions, CR 2.66%, spend $26,051.1.
evidenceIndex.E2: Tracked CR changed from 4.06% (567 / 13,978 sessions, 2026-09-19…2026-10-02) to 2.66% (371 / 13,952 sessions, 2026-10-03…2026-10-16): −1.40 pp (−34.4%); two-proportion z-test p < 0.001, 95% CI of the difference [−1.82 pp, −0.98 pp] — significant; −14.0 tracked conversions/day.
evidenceIndex.E3: Daily conversion rate averaged 4.07% before 2026-10-04 and 2.54% from 2026-10-04 on (change point; 15 vs 13 days, −37.7%).
evidenceIndex.E4: No source explains the CR change out of proportion to its traffic: the largest contributor, google_search, accounts for 50% of the −1.40 pp change with 49.9% of baseline sessions.
evidenceIndex.E5: All 3 source segments changed CR by a similar relative amount (−35.0% to −33.6%); mix effect −0.00 pp, rate effect −1.40 pp.
evidenceIndex.E6: mobile explains 103% of the tracked CR change (−1.43 pp of −1.40 pp): share of sessions 60.2% → 60.0%, CR 3.88% → 1.48%, clicks→sessions 0.9 → 0.9.
evidenceIndex.E7: CR changes differ across device segments (−61.8% to +2.1%); mix effect +0.00 pp, rate effect −1.40 pp.
evidenceIndex.E8: desktop: 5xx rate 0.0% → 0.0%, availability 100.0% → 100.0%, p95 1,002 → 970 ms, p50 769 → 739 ms (56 checks in the current period).
evidenceIndex.E9: mobile: 5xx rate 0.0% → 21.4%, availability 100.0% → 78.6%, p95 1,694 → 8,341 ms, p50 1,303 → 2,982 ms (56 checks in the current period).
evidenceIndex.E10: Deployed version changed v1.9.3 → v2.0.0, first seen by monitoring at 2026-10-04 12:00 UTC.
evidenceIndex.E11: Snapshot of v2.0.0 captured 2026-10-16: form present, tracking tags: gtag; page text is returned as untrusted content.
evidenceIndex.E12: Pixel and backend agree: the pixel recorded 97% of backend-confirmed conversions in the baseline (567 of 586) and 97% in the current period (371 of 382).
evidenceIndex.E13: Largest funnel step change: page_view→form_start 0.1828 → 0.1215 (−33.5%); other steps: form_start→form_submit 0.2688 → 0.2655, form_submit→lead_submitted 0.8425 → 0.8413.
evidenceIndex.E14: Change #1 at 2026-09-28 10:00 UTC, category traffic, by ppc-manager (text in untrusted content).
evidenceIndex.E15: Change #2 at 2026-10-04 09:40 UTC, category deploy, by web-team (text in untrusted content).
evidenceIndex.E16: Change #3 at 2026-10-09 15:00 UTC, category other, by media-buyer (text in untrusted content).

securityNotes: Possible prompt injection in landing page snapshot v2.0.0 (2026-10-16) (signals: ignore_instructions, addresses_ai, report_manipulation, budget_manipulation); the text was treated as data and its instructions were ignored.
